shots.purpose: Open on a New England field under June snow: summer visibly broken, cause nowhere in sight
shots.claim: 1816 brought anomalous summer cold and June snow to New England with no visible cause at the time
shots.evidence: full-bleed plate: snow drifts over a tilled field under a pale overcast sun, no explanation offered yet
shots.motion_reason: slow push-in so the snowed-in field reads as the subject
shots.transition_reason: cut back to the eruption that started it

subject_contract.expected_subject: engraving of a tilled field under June snow with a pale overcast sun

shots.purpose: Show the eruption: a full atmospheric column and the summit gone
shots.claim: Mount Tambora erupted in April 1815 in the largest eruption in recorded history, losing over a kilometre of summit height
shots.evidence: diagram card: volcano column rising into the sky, a dashed ghost outline marking the lost summit above the truncated cone
shots.motion_reason: near-static drift so the eruption column is the motion
shots.transition_reason: cut to the stratospheric veil reveal

subject_contract.expected_subject: engraving diagram: erupting volcano with a tall ash column and a dashed ghost outline of the lost summit

surprise.evidence: the eruption plume rises past the weather into the stratosphere and spreads into a veil ringing the entire globe arc

shots.purpose: Reveal the mechanism: sulfur driven above the weather, where winds spread a planet-wide veil
shots.claim: Tambora injected tens of millions of tonnes of sulfur into the stratosphere, where global winds spread a planet-wide veil
shots.evidence: globe-arc cross-section: a sulfur veil band ringing the arc, rain clouds hugging the surface far below it
shots.motion_reason: drift along the veil so the global spread is the motion

subject_contract.expected_subject: engraving globe-arc: sulfur veil band ringing the planet above low rain clouds

one_second.relationship: the veil rises above the weather and rings the planet

shots.purpose: Split the arithmetic: sun in, sunlight scattered back out, and what half a degree means to a crop
shots.claim: stratospheric sulfate aerosols scattered sunlight and cooled the planet by roughly half a degree Celsius in 1816
shots.evidence: split card: left, sun rays hitting a droplet veil and bouncing back up; right, one young plant under a small frost line
shots.motion_reason: held framing; the scattered-light contrast is the information

subject_contract.expected_subject: engraving split: sun rays bouncing off a droplet veil on the left, a frost-touched seedling on the right

shots.purpose: Show the anomaly month by month: June snow, then frost on repeat through summer
shots.claim: in 1816 June snow fell on New England and killing frosts recurred through the summer months
shots.evidence: timeline card: three field panels labeled June, July, August, each with frost lines through young crops, snow on the June panel
shots.motion_reason: drift along the month panels so the recurring frost is the motion

subject_contract.expected_subject: engraving timeline: three field panels for June, July, August with frost lines and June snow

shots.purpose: Show the human ledger: empty sacks, a bread queue, riots as the ledger of half a degree
shots.claim: the 1816 harvest failures brought soaring prices, famine and food riots; historians describe it as the last great subsistence crisis of the Western world
shots.evidence: engraving card: overturned empty grain sacks in the foreground, a long bread queue receding behind them
shots.motion_reason: near-static drift; the emptiness of the sacks is the information

subject_contract.expected_subject: engraving: empty overturned grain sacks with a bread queue in the background

shots.purpose: Land the argument on the same field under clearing skies: the veil settled, the connection came decades later, the atmosphere is one system
shots.claim: the 1816 climate anomaly was traced to the 1815 Tambora eruption only decades later, after the veil had settled
shots.evidence: dusk reprise: the June-snow field now clear, a few fading veil dots high above a calm sky
shots.motion_reason: slow pull-out, the frame settles as the argument does

subject_contract.expected_subject: engraving of the same field cleared of snow under a calm dusk sky with fading veil dots

one_second.relationship: the sky cleared; the lesson remained
